ideas.title: Fewer, findable longs: 3 a week per channel
ideas.hook: Swap 14 unwatched longs a week for 3 built ones, aimed at watch hours
ideas.why: Every long on both channels is at 0-41 views, including the Marble Run Special the Lab pitched (10 views, 1.6% watched after 6 days). Each channel posts 2 longs a day (14 a week). Metricool's 2026 study of 799,718 videos found 2-4 long uploads a week gave the best results per video, and more than 7 a week lowered total monthly views. YouTube's Feb 1, 2027 YPP rules make long-form watch hours the realistic way in: Shorts pay will need 10M Shorts views per 90 days, and new applicants need 8,000 watch hours (Bounce Theory has ~217K views a month and 165 subs).
ideas.impact: Saves ~2 render hours a day across both channels. Goal: first longs above 100 views and some long-form watch hours each week (now ~0). Results aren't guaranteed; the study is correlational.
ideas.script:
1. Approve this, and the R&D Lab edits agents/formats/youtube-lineup.md on its next run: longs only on Mon, Wed and Fri, 1 per channel each day (3 a week, down from 14). On other days the lineup is 15 Shorts only.
2. Paste the build prompt into Claude Code in YOUTUBE HQ so both video skills make a long only when the lineup has one.
3. Each long uses the Long-Form Doctor's L1/L2 advice plus a Lab Long lead ('Escape to a <place>' rain long, an explainer long), and gets 3 title options.
4. When each long goes public, open YouTube Studio and set it as the 'Related video' on that day's 3 strongest Shorts on the same channel, so Shorts viewers have a path to it (manual, ~2 min).
5. Spend the freed render time on Shorts quality.
Risks: fewer uploads can mean fewer chances to get lucky, so keep at least 3 a week.
Check in 2 weeks: the median views per long should be above the 0-41 baseline, and Studio → Earn should show long-form watch hours moving. If not, go back to the old count.

ideas.title: Keyword-first captions for every TikTok
ideas.hook: Fix the caption half of the reach drop in 10 minutes: keyword line, on-screen keyword, one question
ideas.why: TikTok views fell from ~700 to ~250 since Oct 21, and 15 of the last 20 posts end in 'Follow for more' (TikTok reviewer). Metricool's 2026 TikTok study says TikTok reads the first caption line, on-screen text and the transcript to file a video; question captions get 26.19% more comments, and like-CTAs cut likes by ~60%.
ideas.impact: Better topic matching and search reach; realistic goal is getting back to the ~700-view floor within 2 weeks (not guaranteed, since part of the drop may be account-level)
ideas.script:
1. Update the content-scripts skill so every script ends with a caption block: line 1 = the search phrase (e.g. 'stoic advice for young muslim men'), line 2 = one specific question, then 2-4 specific hashtags (no #fyp/#viral).
2. Add an on-screen text cue in scene 1 with the same phrase in the first 3 seconds, and make sure the phrase is said out loud in the first sentence.
3. Ban 'Follow for more' and any 'like if…' line.
4. Turn on auto-captions in TikTok and fix wrong words before posting.
5. Track the next 10 posts in the TikTok reviewer's table: views, comments, search share if shown.
Risk: the drop may be account-level (Oct 21), so captions alone may not fix it; the reviewer should keep watching.
Worked if: the 10 posts after the change average above the ~250 views of the last five, and comments rise.

ideas.title: Growth Architect: free plan pages + welcome emails
ideas.hook: Search traffic and a 3-email onboarding using features Base44 just shipped
ideas.why: Base44 added an SEO & GEO dashboard (meta tags, sitemap, llms.txt, Search Console rolling out) and branded workflow emails on Oct 6, 2026, plus a Payments tab on Oct 15. Rivals such as AirOps use a free 'AI marketing plan generator' page as their funnel. The Growth Architect team hasn't run yet, so the app has no growth loop on record.
ideas.impact: A free, compounding traffic source (5-10 landing pages) and more signups finishing their first plan; realistic first results in 4-8 weeks
ideas.cost: $0 for SEO; editing built-in emails needs the Builder plan, workflow emails per Base44's plan terms
ideas.script:
1. In Base44, open the SEO & GEO dashboard for Growth Architect and fix every checklist item (titles, meta descriptions, sitemap, llms.txt).
2. Create 5 public pages: 'Free AI marketing plan for a barbershop / restaurant / Shopify store / local cleaner / coach', each with a short sample plan and a 'make yours' button.
3. Add a 3-email onboarding workflow: welcome (start your first plan), day 2 (finish it: here's what's missing), day 5 (try the weekly planner).
4. Connect Search Console when the integration reaches his account.
5. Watch the Payments tab weekly.
Risks: thin pages rank poorly (make each sample plan useful); plan limits on emails.
Worked if: in 4 weeks pages are indexed and at least a few signups come from search; email-driven return rate is visible.
ideas.buildPrompt: I have a Base44 app called Growth Architect (app id 699b4057d65174480989a52e): an AI marketing-plan web app with agents, a money tab, weekly planner, market test and competitor watch, using the Claude API. Please use the Base44 tools to: 1) Read the app's current pages and entities first and tell me what exists. 2) Propose (and after I say yes, build) 5 public landing pages, 'Free AI marketing plan for a barbershop / restaurant / Shopify store / local cleaning business / online coach', each with a short, genuinely useful sample plan and a 'Make yours free' button into the app's signup. 3) Give me the exact SEO settings for each page (title under 60 chars, meta description under 155) to enter in Base44's SEO & GEO dashboard, and tell me which checklist items to fix. 4) Draft a 3-email onboarding sequence (welcome, day 2 'finish your plan', day 5 'try the weekly planner') to set up with Base44's Emails workflow, and tell me which plan it needs. Don't run any paid ads, don't change pricing, and don't publish without asking me.

ideas.title: SATR Ramadan 2027 runway plan
ideas.hook: Start SATR's Ramadan push 3 months early, when Quran gifts peak
ideas.why: Ramadan 2027 is expected to begin around Feb 8, 2027 (moon-sighting dependent), and Ramadan gifting of religious items surges online. TikTok's own case study: religious publisher Ummul Qura's Ramadan TikTok campaign got +23% purchases, +14% GMV and 1.9x ROI. SATR has no plan in Agent HQ yet.
ideas.impact: Ready-made content and store pages before demand peaks; Ramadan is likely SATR's biggest sales window of the year
ideas.effort: 2h to plan, then ~30 min a week
ideas.cost: $0 organic (any ads are Omar's call later)
ideas.script:
1. Build a simple calendar: Nov-Dec content (cover close-ups, 'gift for your mum' angles), January pre-orders and shipping cut-off dates, Ramadan weeks 1-2 last-chance posts, Eid gifting.
2. Shopify: a 'Ramadan gift' collection, a gift-note option and clear Canada shipping dates.
3. TikTok: 12 faceless product clips (hands, cover textures, unboxing) planned now, posted 2-3 a week.
4. Check whether TikTok Shop is open to his seller location before planning around it; otherwise link the Shopify store.
Risks: stock and shipping times (order stock by early January); any paid ads need Omar's approval.
Also add a short 'how to choose a Quran cover' guide page for search, and ask the first buyers for a photo review.
Worked if: by mid-January there are 10+ posted clips, the collection is live, and pre-order or add-to-cart numbers are rising week to week.
ideas.buildPrompt: I run SATR, a small Shopify brand selling Quran covers, based in Mississauga, Ontario. Ramadan 2027 is expected to start around Feb 8, 2027. Build me a Ramadan 2027 runway plan: 1) A week-by-week calendar from November 2026 to Eid al-Fitr 2027 with what to post, what to change on the store, and stock/shipping cut-off dates for Canada (ask me my supplier lead time). 2) Twelve faceless TikTok/Reels clip ideas I can shoot with my phone in one afternoon (close-ups, textures, unboxing, gift angles), each with a hook line and caption. 3) The exact Shopify changes: a 'Ramadan gifts' collection, gift-note option, product description rewrites (ask me to paste my current ones). 4) Tell me how to check whether TikTok Shop is available to me as a seller and what to do if it isn't. Keep everything halal and respectful of the Quran. Don't post, buy ads or change my store yourself.

brief.headline: Make 3 good longs a week, not 14 unwatched ones
brief.summary: Your best upgrade today is cutting longs to 3 a week per channel. Every long you've posted is at 0-41 views, including my Marble Run Special pick (10 views, 1.6% watched), and Metricool's data says 2-4 longs a week beat 7+. YouTube's new rules from Feb 1 also mean Shorts alone won't pay at your size, so long-form watch hours are the way in. Best new format lead: 'Can The Ball Reach Final Form' (122,773 views, 9.4x its channel) for Bounce Theory. No agents hired or removed.
filmToday: Fewer, findable longs: 3 a week per channel — approve it, then paste its build prompt into Claude Code in YOUTUBE HQ
notes: YouTube's YPP changes on Feb 1, 2027: Shorts revenue needs 10M qualified Shorts views in 90 days, and new applicants need 1,000 subs plus 8,000 watch hours (or 20M Shorts views). Until then it's 1,000 subs + 4,000 hours or 10M Shorts views. Archived live streams count as watch hours, which is why there's a live-battle lead.

MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 is an open text-to-sound model (Apache 2.0 according to a review; I couldn't open the model page to confirm). It could make richer rain and fire layers, but discovery is what's holding the longs back, not audio, so I didn't pitch it yet.

Team requests answered: Google's AI calling still isn't in Canada (Opps); Simplify has ~500K users and 4.8★ (LinkedAI); no free ads source with performance data (Growth). I still found no Islamic quiz Shorts channel with public view numbers (YouTube), and no solid data on TikTok reach drops.

formatLeads.name: Final Form ball evolution

example.title: Can The Ball Reach Final Form #satisfyingvideo #bouncingball #physics
example.creator: ASMR Ball Simulations

formatLeads.howToMake: New sims.py variant of the ball-grows logic: every N bounces the ball evolves to the next tier (colour, glow, trail, shape, size) with an on-screen 'FORM 3/7' counter and a tier-up sound; the last form is the spectacle (rainbow trail + burst). 25-35 s, one ball, one ring. Test slot until it has numbers.
formatLeads.why: An evolution goal gives a reason to wait for the end, like the re-align payoff on his 32K pendulum wave; Ambient Escape's 'Every bounce, the ball gets BIGGER' already hit 3,417.

formatLeads.name: Live physics battle (archived live stream)

example.title: FLAG WASH LIVE 🌍🫧 Which Country Will Survive? | Country Balls Battle
example.creator: Battle Island

formatLeads.howToMake: Loop an endless sims.py battle (colour teams or country flags, no club names) and stream it with OBS for 1-3 hours, archived as public. Needs a one-time OBS + stream-key setup on the laptop, so it is a Test, not a daily slot.
formatLeads.why: Archived livestreams count toward YPP watch hours, and his longs earn almost none; a live also gets its own Live feed slot.

formatLeads.name: 'Every X explained in N minutes' Islamic explainer long

example.title: Every Ironman Suit Explained in 15 Minutes
example.creator: Stickman 616

formatLeads.howToMake: Chain explainer.py list scenes into a 10-15 min long, e.g. 'Every Major Sign of the Day of Judgement Explained in 12 Minutes': one scene per point with counter, gold keyword and source; AI voice optional, never Omar's voice; never depict prophets or companions (scenes and text only); sahih/hasan sources only, script checked before render.
formatLeads.why: Simple-art 'explained' longs win on script and a complete-list promise (The Paint Explainer 2.01M subs, EverythingProfessor 677K per TaleTok); Ambient's explainer Shorts start today, so the scenes already exist.

formatLeads.name: 'Escape to a <place>' rain sleep long

example.title: Rain Sounds for Deep Sleep | Escape to a Cozy Forest Cabin
example.creator: Rainful

formatLeads.howToMake: One forest-cabin stock clip (Pexels/Pixabay) looped with his rain + soft fire layers, 3 h, title 'Rain Sounds for Deep Sleep | Escape to a <place>'. Never reciter audio.
formatLeads.why: Fresh 11x outlier, 1 day old; the place-in-the-title pattern matches the Long-Form Doctor's diagnosis.

formatLeads.name: Named-city rain clip Short
formatLeads.howToMake: 10-15 s real rain stock clip of a named city street or window (Pexels/Pixabay, location from the clip page) + his rain layer, title '<City> rain at night 🌧️ #rain #rainsounds #shorts'. Only name a city the clip really shows, and never say 'right now'.
formatLeads.why: Biggest outlier in today's scan; place + weather is a search people make. Low effort, so a cheap Test.
